races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Nursery
races.verdict:
MAGICAL LIFE took apart a Kempton nursery to open her account last week. Wisely turned out quickly under a penalty, Stan Moore's filly is fancied to follow up at the expense of Parading, who ran his best race when runner-up on nursery bow at Ffos Las recently and that form has since received a boost. Pequenita completes the shortlist making this quick switch to a nursery.

  1. MAGICAL LIFE
  2. PARADING
  3. PEQUENITA

races.name: Singapore Pools Trophy Race Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JUSTICE COURT took a step forward when pushing the odds-on favourite close at this venue on his return and he is taken to go one better with further progress to come. The main danger could be Itica, who could yet do better on the back of being gelded, ahead of stable-switcher Rapide Vega.

  1. JUSTICE COURT (IRE)
  2. ITICA
  3. RAPIDE VEGA (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap
races.verdict:
With Belle of Kt's participation in doubt (7-length winner here on Saturday evening), LE ROUGE CHINOIS is selected to go one better than on return for his former yard at Yarmouth 12 days ago. Star of Jupiter ran better for a while when second at Catterick earlier in the month and provided that wasn't a flash in the pan, he can also feature.

  1. LE ROUGE CHINOIS (DEN)
  2. BELLE OF KT
  3. STAR OF JUPITER (IRE)

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Potentially a good opportunity for VEIL OF CLOUDS who wasn't seen to best effect on her handicap bow at Wolverhampton last time. Egotistical rates the main threat in a thin race.

  1. VEIL OF CLOUDS
  2. EGOTISTICAL
  3. DARK BRUNETTE (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for PURE PASSION to double her tally having been caught wide throughout when finishing runner-up at this track 4 days ago. Saeculamation was placed at Nottingham last month and he could be the one to provide most resistance, with Star Marian also worth a second look partnered by Oisin Murphy for the first time.

  1. PURE PASSION
  2. SAECULAMATION (IRE)
  3. STAR MARIAN

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
HOVE RANGER ran well when third behind a pair of better-positioned rivals in a steadily-run race at Brighton last time and has previously shaped as if this longer trip should suit. He can double his tally at the expense of Uzincso, who arrives in good heart for his in-form yard, with Forca Timao completing the shortlist.

  1. HOVE RANGER (FR)
  2. UZINCSO
  3. FORCA TIMAO (IRE)

races.name: Cavani Style & Speed Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
This may not be the ideal set-up for ZIGGY'S QUEEN, but she's worth chancing on the strength of her all-weather form last winter. Unexposed 3-y-o Celtic Arrow is feared most, with Dream Illusion, Angels' Share and So Sassy also appealing in a competitive opener.

  1. ZIGGY'S QUEEN (IRE)
  2. CELTIC ARROW (FR)
  3. DREAM ILLUSION

races.name: Race And Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not a race to be going overboard about. HALCON has been off for 8 weeks but still looks the percentage call following her debut third at Ripon. Forest Berry is capable of running a big race if she settles, while Pon Pon Dalia may show more second time up.

  1. HALCON
  2. FOREST BERRY
  3. PON PON DALIA (IRE)

races.name: Cavani Sprint In Style Nursery (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A competitive nursery that could go the way of SYDNEY GRACE, who created a good impression when winning at Carlisle in June. Wondervision also looks interesting on her nursery bow, with Green Titan and Nascent Star others to consider.

  1. SYDNEY GRACE (IRE)
  2. WONDERVISION (IRE)
  3. GREEN TITAN

races.name: Cavani Sprint In Style Nursery (Div 2)
races.verdict:
REX REGUM and Sea Palace appeal most in an open-looking nursery, with Tom Clover's charge narrowly preferred. Seed Ya Later looks interesting on her all-weather bow, while Cailin Aine also merits respect.

  1. REX REGUM
  2. SEA PALACE
  3. SEED YA LATER (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
A few in with chances but STYLE KING arrives at the top of his game and reunited with Silvestre de Sousa, Chris Dwyer's 4-y-o can notch his third career success. Maharajas Express had a bit in hand when getting up late at Chester last month, so he could emerge as the main danger, while Dicko The Legend has dropped to a handy mark so completes the shortlist.

  1. STYLE KING (IRE)
  2. MAHARAJAS EXPRESS
  3. DICKO THE LEGEND (IRE)

races.name: Book Hotel And Conferencing At Wolverhampton Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
Most of these arrive out of sorts but a chance is taken on MEGAPHONE dropping into this grade for the first time. 3-time C&D winner Alafdhal also has his first taste of classified company so he may give the selection most to do, with Our Hero Matty rounding off the shortlist.

  1. MEGAPHONE
  2. ALAFDHAL (IRE)
  3. OUR HERO MATTY (IRE)

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
JAMES CHOICE upped his game when second at Southwell 3 weeks ago and with further improvement on the cards now tackling an even longer trip, Warren Greatrex's 3-y-o gets the vote to open his account. Prince of Calypso finished a place behind the selection last time and he's put forward as the main threat, while Pace Attack looks a typical Sir Mark Prescott improver now handicapping so market support could well prove significant.

  1. JAMES CHOICE
  2. PRINCE OF CALYPSO (IRE)
  3. PACE ATTACK (IRE)

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SUNLIT SEA has already scored for Poppy Scott this season and Sir Mark Prescott's filly can regain the winning thread. South Shore and Thornaby Pearl also arrive here in top form and complete the shortlist.

  1. SUNLIT SEA
  2. SOUTH SHORE
  3. THORNABY PEARL

races.name: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MITHAALY should take plenty of beating. Fairy Well and newcomer Nobelos stand out as the dangers, with Astralite a potential improver.

  1. MITHAALY
  2. FAIRY WELL (IRE)
  3. NOBELOS (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Get 40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Nursery
races.verdict:
PAPER VIEW shaped as if still in good form at Glorious Goodwood so can quickly return to winning ways back down in class. This does look competitive, though, with the progressive Black Velvet Boy heading the dangers.

  1. PAPER VIEW (IRE)
  2. BLACK VELVET BOY (IRE)
  3. MAGIC EFFORT

races.name: Matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
Hard to rule any of these out, but RAY MON DOUGH looks well on his way to becoming a smart sprinter and can defy a penalty for his Leicester win 8 days ago. Waistcoat is another player on the back of his Newbury win, whilst last year's third Under The Twilight should be in the mix again after a fine effort at Glorious Goodwood.

  1. RAY MON DOUGH
  2. WAISTCOAT
  3. UNDER THE TWILIGHT

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
YES WALIIM escapes a penalty for last week's Lingfield win and can follow up at the chief expense of Jackie Brown, who did well to score at Bath last time and Sisters In The Sky, who should benefit from this step back up in trip.

  1. YES WALIIM (IRE)
  2. JACKIE BROWN (IRE)
  3. SISTERS IN THE SKY

races.name: Matchbook Handicap
races.verdict:
Having opened his account at Yarmouth on his penultimate start, HIGHLAND HARVEY confirmed himself still in good form when placed over further back at that venue 12 days ago. He rates a big player again from an unchanged mark, with 3-y-o Risk Averse Rebel and Pershalla heading up the dangers.

  1. HIGHLAND HARVEY (IRE)
  2. RISK AVERSE REBEL (IRE)
  3. PERSHALLA

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
Hard to split last year's 1-2 STELLARMASTERPIECE and Star Start, who both arrive in top form. Austrian Theory is lurking on a dangerous mark and may prove best of the others.

  1. STELLARMASTERPIECE (FR)
  2. STAR START (IRE)
  3. AUSTRIAN THEORY (IRE)

races.name: Well-Earned Retirement Neal Kidd Nursery
races.verdict:
SO TEMPTING showed big improvement when only just failing to reel in a subsequent winner on nursery debut at Chepstow last month and can make amends off only 1 lb higher. Aura of Melania split a pair of subsequent winners herself when third at Ripon so she rates the main threat.

  1. SO TEMPTING
  2. AURA OF MELANIA
  3. HARRY'S POP

races.name: Chapman Milestones Celebration, Thank You NHS Handicap
races.verdict:
PAPA DON'T PREACH has been in good form since returning from a break, narrowly denied at Yarmouth 15 days ago, and he could be ready to take advantage of his current mark. Edmond Halley ran well on his second start for the in-form Ed Bethell and is feared most, while Jm Jhingree is also capable of getting involved.

  1. PAPA DON'T PREACH (IRE)
  2. EDMOND HALLEY (IRE)
  3. JM JHINGREE (IRE)

races.name: Constant Security Services Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NIGHT SHINING has been found a good opportunity and will surely be priced accordingly. Star Noir looks the most likely to cause an upset.

  1. NIGHT SHINING (IRE)
  2. STAR NOIR
  3. PREFERRED

races.name: racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for TEES AGGREGATES, who won here in June and is well worth another chance after running in class 4 company both starts since. Returned to this grade, he gets the vote ahead of another C&D winner this season Irish Dancer, with Cheerleader also considered from her last winning mark.

  1. TEES AGGREGATES (IRE)
  2. IRISH DANCER (IRE)
  3. CHEERLEADER

races.name: Racing Again 26th August Handicap
races.verdict:
A tricky finale to solve but the vote goes to EVOCATIVE SPARK, who shaped as if better for the run at Haydock recently and John Riches' 7-y-o can add a fourth C&D success to his CV. Classy Clarets rates as an obvious danger having rattled off a 4-timer in the space of 17 days recently, with Runninsonofagun and Emerald Army another couple fancied to be in the shake-up, as well.

  1. EVOCATIVE SPARK (IRE)
  2. CLASSY CLARETS (IRE)
  3. RUNNINSONOFAGUN (IRE)
